boundary: Public web case notes for marriage timing adjudication. Use as MEVG calibration, not as proof of deterministic prediction.

rules.description: A marriage event can occur outside Venus/Jupiter/Saturn-led periods when the active dasha lord is tied to the marriage network and is confirmed by subperiod, Jaimini/Narayana or transit support.
Rahu/Ketu can trigger marriage when connected to 7H/7L/Venus/Jupiter/DK/UL/D9, often with nontraditional, sudden, cross-cultural, secretive or pressured relationship texture.
Mercury can act as a marriage proxy when it owns, occupies, aspects or disposits marriage factors; channel often appears through communication, study, work, friends, documents or online contact.
Moon can act as a marriage proxy when it links to 7L/7H/D9/UL; manifestation often comes through family, cohabitation, emotional dependence or domestic security.

cases.lesson: Rahu/Moon/Mercury can still time marriage when Mercury functions as 7L and Jaimini/D9 support the marriage axis.
Ketu period is not automatically anti-marriage; if Ketu is Venus-colored and Mercury is 7L, it can deliver marriage.
Rahu can deliver marriage when D9 and Venus-derived relationship houses are directly involved.
Moon/Mercury periods can coincide with marriage when the natal relationship promise is strong and Mercury/Moon connect to the marriage field.
Mercury/Rahu can be decisive when Vimshottari subperiods and Narayana Dasha both route through marriage significators.
